summary:
Stone 1 plan written to /tmp/claude-3003/-mnt-pool1-home-guru-eac/7236b31a-7646-4e28-8b29-be60fa6c575f/scratchpad/team/4-build-plan-stone-1.md. No file in the tree, container or row was changed; scratch runs used read-only mounts and isolated Chromium, and are in team/lead-baseline/.

Scope: a sealed block's declared props become editable in the right column on the test page, data blocks draw from sample() without storing rows, and one failing block draws a named stand-in. It is additive: TreeEditorOptions.contract is optional, so a host that does not pass it behaves as before.

Review items:
- Applied to stone 1: seed document, empty-wall behaviour, read-only Code tab JSON, test.html wrapper, "Show as published", Detach refused on sample rows, look-prop guards, picture privacy on typed addresses, groupOf colour case.
- Could not apply here because they concern later stones: the three blocking objections (split stone 8, a first-artist and roll-out stone, code-built pages) and the other should-change items. They are listed with their earliest stone for the synthesis's owner. Stone 1 forecloses none of them.

Measured this pass:
- tsc: direct-edit 0 errors; blocks 2 errors, both in services/src/gather.ts:704,706, so "check-types 0 in blocks" cannot pass and becomes no new errors; arts-collective 0; innergathering 0.
- Drivers: drive 43, drive4 39, drive5 14, drive6 35, drive7 18, drive8 29, drive9 54, drive10 46, drive11 56, drive12 20, 0 failures. drive5 and drive12 need pages assembled from the land data in the published test page.
- Page assembly: rehearsed with the recovered wrapper; smoke.cjs mounted all five views with 0 errors.

Defects found:
- runall.sh fails as stored (invalid mode: /w) because of single-quoted expansion.
- panel.ts:574 splits on ":", so slot ids must not hold a colon.
- An esbuild entry named blocks.ts would overwrite blocks.css.
- History's 800 ms window would split a title typed with a pause.
- adopt would copy empty-label and stand-in text into the document.

Product fact for the developer: 13 of 30 shared blocks draw nothing on Add until filled, three of them (questions, picture wall, dated list) until stone 3.

Not verified: the claude.ai sandbox allowing data: images (assumed); anything signed in or on a real host; Firefox, Safari, touch.
